title: FloodConnect M8 advice
description: jev_decision.advice -- the new advice layer (D: preparedness ladder, E: home-as-shelter). `prepare_steps` is built from advice/preparedness_ladder.yaml by colour (P-D, not built in P-B). `home_shelter` is built from advice/home_shelter.py (P-C, not built in P-B). `public_shelter` stays OPEN while site/inputs/community/public_shelter_seeds.yaml has no real sites. In a P-B-only build this object may be absent or carry empty/placeholder values -- a caller must not read an empty prepare_steps as 'nothing to prepare'.

prepare_steps.description: Ordered -- the emergency card's `do_th` is prepare_steps[0].what_th. `kb.py`'s non-verbose (compact) jev_decision carries only the COMPACT item form below (token budget, tests/test_token_budget.py: the full what_th/how_th text of even 3 real steps pushed every budget test over its ceiling once P-D populated real ladder content) -- the full text is still on `verbose=True`, and is never actually lost even in compact mode, since it is the SAME text already carried by `emergency_card.do_th` in the same answer.

what_th.description: เตรียมอะไร

how_th.description: เตรียมอย่างไร

trigger_next.description: What advances to the next step, e.g. 'ORANGE', 'Z0 RISING', 'ประกาศทางการ', or '-' for the terminal UNKNOWN row.

official_ref.description: official_guidance.yaml row ids backing this step -- empty/absent only when source_tag is FLOODCONNECT.

oneOf.description: Compact form (verbose=False) -- a pointer only, see this property's own top-level description.

confidence.description: Present only when below HIGH -- either the verdict was reached despite an unresolved colour (P-C design rule 9: UNKNOWN colour with complete household inputs gives PREPARE_TO_LEAVE at LOW, never HIGH/MEDIUM), or FIX5B's own missing-vulnerable-input downgrade (`calc.missing` non-empty) lowered it by one ordinal step per missing category.

calc.description: FIX5B: the inputs behind this verdict and which of them were missing, never fabricated. `eq` names the FloodConnect-internal confidence-downgrade rule (pending the founder, same status as `rule`/`tag` below); `inputs` lists `member_need_profile` and `animal_profile`, each with its declared value or `source: missing`. A profile that is wholly absent (`null`) is `missing`; an explicit declaration -- including `{}` or an animal count of 0, i.e. 'checked, none' -- is `declared` and never lowers confidence on its own. `missing` repeats the missing names; `reasons` (when present) is the plain-Thai reason for each downgrade actually applied.

missing_inputs.description: Non-empty whenever verdict == UNKNOWN_ASK_INPUTS -- missing input must never silently resolve to STAY.

protective_state_raw.description: The raw shelter_decision.recommend_protective_state() result, kept verbatim alongside the folded verdict.

rule.description: Present only when the verdict was reached via advice/home_shelter.py's rules 4-9 (FloodConnect's own escalation defaults, e.g. R7/R9 -- never rule 1/3, which are founder-mandated safety invariants, not defaults).

tag.description: Present alongside `rule` -- marks this verdict as this repo's own default, pending founder confirmation.
